name: Google Cloud
blurb: Short-lived tokens minted on this machine for gcloud and Google APIs.
guide: Log in on this machine as you normally do: gcloud auth login.
MWT runs the command below whenever the VM needs a token and keeps the result until shortly before it expires. Your login stays here; the VM only sees a placeholder.
gcloud auth print-access-token acts as you. Add --impersonate-service-account=NAME@PROJECT.iam.gserviceaccount.com to act as a narrower service account instead.
